So therefore whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.

parallels.note: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”

translations.web: A scribe came, and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”
translations.bsb: And one of the scribes came to Him and said, “Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go.”
translations.kjv: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
translations.asv: And there came a scribe, and said unto him, Teacher, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
